name: Worten Conector
author: teracondition

sections.description:
Official Worten Partner. 7-day trial available.

Worten Conector keeps your catalog, offers (price/stock) and orders synchronized between WooCommerce and Worten Marketplace (Mirakl)—so you can manage everything from your store without duplicated work.

Integration runs through our cloud connector (AWS), reducing load on your server and providing faster, safer communication with Worten.

Note: Offers (price, stock, handling times) are updated automatically after activation. Product creation is handled per store to ensure correct categories/attributes.

Why you’ll love it

  • Automatic Offers sync: price, stock, VAT, handling times.
  • Smart Product handling: only creates products when needed; otherwise sends them as offers to existing listings.
  • Order integration (optional): bi-directional sync centralized in WooCommerce—receive Worten orders in your store and push confirmations, cancellations, shipping & tracking back to Worten.
  • Tracking made easy: select carrier, add tracking number, and mark orders as Completed to update Worten.
  • Low footprint: cloud processing, minimal impact on your store.

Products vs Offers (how Mirakl/Worten works)

  • Product = unique catalog item identified by EAN in Worten. It’s created once in the marketplace.
  • Offer = your store’s commercial details for that Product (price, stock, VAT, SLA, etc.).

If a Product already exists in Worten (by EAN), your update is sent as an Offer.
If it doesn’t exist, Product creation is carried out by each store using our category-aware attribute tool: it presents the mandatory Worten attributes for the selected category, enables per-store mapping to your WooCommerce data, and validates completeness before submission. This is an administrative workflow managed by each store.

WooCommerce doesn’t ship with a native EAN field—but that’s not a problem. Worten Conector works with popular EAN/UPC/ISBN plugins and can read your EANs from those fields. Per-store mapping lets you point the connector to the exact meta field used by your plugin, so EAN capture “just works” across simple and variable products. If you manufacture items, you can use your own EANs; however, using the manufacturer’s EAN is recommended for catalog consistency.

How it works (Products)

  1. Import products from your store.
  2. Sync with Worten via the cloud connector.
  3. Existing products (by EAN) become Offers with immediate sync for price/stock/VAT/handling times.
  4. Identify products missing from Worten’s catalog.
  5. Prepare per-store product creation (mandatory categories/attributes).
  6. Submit, monitor, and finalize—then manage as Offers.

How it works (Offers)

  • Import your catalog and push all offers for products already in Worten.
  • Keep prices, stock, VAT, handling times up to date.
  • Define delivery timelines and global or category margins.
  • Continuous monitoring.

Order Integration (optional module)

  • Bi-directional, centralized in WooCommerce: manage marketplace orders end-to-end from your store.
  • Customer orders in Worten → an order is created in WooCommerce.
  • Approve or confirm/cancel in WooCommerce; status is mirrored back to Worten.
  • Choose carrier and add a tracking number, then mark the order Completed to notify Worten (requires the Worten Conector – Tracking for Orders plugin).
  • Stock is updated accordingly.
  • Currently available for WooCommerce.

Technology

  • Amazon Web Services (AWS)
  • Secure Cloud Infrastructure
  • SQL Server Database
  • .NET Core backend for the connector
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins in your WordPress admin.
  2. Click Add New.
  3. Search for Worten Conector and click Install Now (or Upload Plugin and choose worten-conector.zip).
  4. Click Activate.
sections.faq:
Does it create products automatically?

Offers are automated after activation. Product creation is per-store to ensure correct categories/attributes and data quality.

Do I need EANs?

Yes. Marketplaces (including Worten) use EAN as the product identifier, so you must provide it—without an EAN, integration isn’t possible. WooCommerce doesn’t include a native EAN field, but you can install any popular EAN/UPC/ISBN plugin; our connector recognizes those fields and maps them per store.

Which countries are supported?

Portugal and Spain via Worten (Mirakl).

Is the order module required?

No. It’s optional and can be subscribed in the Mirakl Connector backoffice.

How is tracking sent to Worten?

In WooCommerce, select the carrier, add the tracking number, and set the order to Completed. The connector updates Worten accordingly.

Will this slow down my site?

No. Processing runs in our cloud connector, keeping your WooCommerce fast.

Can I set margins per category?

Yes. You can define global and/or category-specific margins.

What gets synced automatically?

Offers: prices, stock, VAT, and handling times.
Orders (with order module): creation, confirmation/cancellation, and shipping/tracking updates (requires the Worten Conector – Tracking for Orders plugin).

What are the requirements?

WordPress 5.8+, PHP 7.4+. WooCommerce plugin installed and active.

How do I start the trial?

Install, activate, and follow the onboarding. The 7-day trial is available through the connector backoffice.
sections.changelog:
2.8 – 2025-08-14

  • Compatible with WordPress 6.8.2.
  • Now part of the Syncmerce platform: keep Worten active and optionally subscribe/integrate other marketplaces (e.g., Fnac, Kuanto Kusta, Leroy Merlin, Carrefour …).
  • Multi-marketplace groundwork: unified credentials & environment selector in the connector backoffice.
  • Attribute mapping tool: clearer per-store workflows, mandatory-attribute prompts for each Worten category, and pre-validation before submission.
  • EAN handling: auto-detects popular EAN/UPC/ISBN plugins and allows per-store meta mapping
  • Offers engine: smoother price/stock/VAT/handling-time updates with smarter batching and retries under API throttling.
  • Logs & observability: centralized error traces with actionable hints; easier support hand-off.
  • Minor UI polish and copy updates across onboarding and settings.

2.7 – 2025-07-17

  • Compatible with WordPress 6.8.2.
  • Order module refinements: truly bi-directional flow centralized in WooCommerce (confirm/cancel/ship in WC; mirror to Worten).
  • Shipping workflow: carrier selection + tracking number UX improved (supports the companion plugin Worten Conector – Tracking for Orders).
  • Category/attribute assistant: faster category search, inline tips for required attributes.
  • Performance: reduced payload size on offer sync; adaptive batch sizes for large catalogs.
  • Stability: better handling of transient Mirakl errors and network timeouts with exponential backoff.

2.6 – 2024-12-19

  • Compatible with WordPress 6.7.1.

2.5 – 2024-05-28

  • Compatible with WordPress 6.5.3.
  • Add margins by categories.

2.4 – 2023-11-20

  • Compatible with WordPress 6.4.1.

2.3 – 2023-10-20

  • Compatible with WordPress 6.3.2.

2.2 – 2023-10-10

  • Update for WordPress 6.3.1.

2.0 – 2023-02-03

  • Order fulfillment & shipping management implementation.

1.0.1 – 2022-05-25

  • Birthday of Worten Conector.
